dedup: Checked DOI/arXiv/version aliases and normalized title against the parent Git evidence objects, expanded tar member files, other gzip articles and early baseline. Compared first-author surname and near titles in historical catalogue rows. A mention in earlier source material is conservatively classified as historical.
family_handling: The Bristol data article and city-scale analysis describe the same test track and release. They are separate publications and share the measurement campaign.

The two MASA conference articles have separate DOIs and authorship orders, with substantial site/equipment overlap. They are listed under the journal/conference DOI with the corresponding arXiv alias.
The Warburton sensorimotor-latency preprint and published journal record are combined under the journal DOI.
The 2014 wired one-hop circuit conference report and later multihop journal article share laboratory hardware; both are marked as related descriptions.
The earlier two-vehicle, three-car and six-car platoon reports and later extensions may share investigators or vehicles. Article counts cannot be used as independent-fleet counts.
limitations: Open index availability varied (429 and connection timeouts logged). Experiments, numerical demonstrations, user studies and transceiver-only results are separated in the scope annotations. Clocks, denominators, sampling, radio transport and mechanical/visual endpoints differ by source. Raw data and full texts are not mirrored in this catalogue.
